chunks.heading: Quarterly allowance
chunks.text: Eligible Medicare Advantage members receive a quarterly allowance on the OTC card. The amount depends on the plan. Unused balance does not roll over at the end of the quarter.
chunks.embedText: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Benefit Card | Quarterly allowance | Eligible Medicare Advantage members receive a quarterly allowance on the OTC card. The amount depends on the plan. Unused balance does not roll over at the end of the quarter.

chunks.heading: Where the card works
chunks.text: The card works at participating retail stores and through the OTC catalog by phone or online. Eligible items include pain relievers, cold medicine, first aid supplies and vitamins.
chunks.embedText: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Benefit Card | Where the card works | The card works at participating retail stores and through the OTC catalog by phone or online. Eligible items include pain relievers, cold medicine, first aid supplies and vitamins.

chunks.heading: Lost card or balance questions
chunks.text: Members can check the balance in the member portal or by calling the number on the back of the card. A replacement card ships in 7 to 10 days and the remaining balance transfers automatically.
